feats.title: Elven Luck
feats.description: When you use your elven accuracy power, you gain a +1d4 bonus to the reroll

feats.title: Opportunistic Accuracy
feats.description: If you use your elven accuracy racial power to reroll an opportunity attack and the second roll misses, you do not expend the power

feats.title: Elven Precision
feats.description: When you use your Elven accuracy power, you gain a +2 bonus to the new attack roll. You also gain a +2 feat bonus to Thievery checks. At 21st level, this feat bonus increases to +3.

feats.title: Shimmering Elf
feats.description: Immediately after you use elven accuracy, you can teleport up to 2 squares as a free action

feats.title: Elven Sidestep
feats.description: When you move, the first square of your movement does not provoke opportunity attacks from enemies you have marked

feats.title: Eyes of the Forest
feats.description: Each ally affected by your Group Awareness trait doesn't take the -2 penalty for attacking an enemy that has partial concealment

feats.title: Elven Empathy
feats.description: When one of your allies within 10 squares of you spends a healing surge to regain hit points, he or she regains 1 additional hit point. The additional hit points gained increase to 2 at 11th level, and 3 at 21st level

feats.title: Running Shot
feats.description: You don't take an attack penalty to ranged attacks after you use the run action.

feats.title: Light Step
feats.description: Whenever you willingly enter a square and there is a trap triggered by entering that square, you make a saving throw. If you succeed on the saving throw, you do not trigger the trap. You also gain a +2 feat bonus to Stealth checks. At 21st level, this feat bonus increases to +3.
